reason: The README describes a DSH web plugin whose primary purpose is monitoring continuous and late-night use and notifying users with configurable rest reminders and UI interruption; it states that data is persisted locally and no external network calls are used.

summaries.zh: 一个通过监测 DSH 中的连续和深夜操作并在网页界面显示可配置休息提醒的宠物插件。
summaries.en: A pet-style DSH web plugin that monitors continuous and late-night activity and displays configurable rest reminders in the interface.

capabilities: Monitors real user activity events in DSH sessions
Tracks and persists continuous-work timing locally
Displays reminders and an optional full-screen blocking overlay in the web UI
Provides local HTTP endpoints for state retrieval and user acknowledgement
